//@version=6
indicator("ICT/SMC Advanced Forecaster Pro", "ICT Forecaster Pro", overlay = true, max_boxes_count = 500, max_labels_count = 500, max_lines_count = 500)

// --- Constants ---
string G_SESS  = "Sessions"
string G_MA    = "Moving Averages"
string G_VIS   = "Visuals & Strategy"
color C_GREEN  = #089981
color C_RED    = #f23645
color C_BLUE   = #2196f3
color C_BG     = #131722

// --- Inputs ---
asiaSessInput   = input.session("0000-0600", "Asian Session", group = G_SESS)
londonSessInput = input.session("0800-1200", "London Session", group = G_SESS)
nySessInput     = input.session("1300-1700", "New York Session", group = G_SESS)
timeZoneInput   = input.string("UTC", "Timezone", options = ["UTC", "America/New_York", "Europe/London"], group = G_SESS)

tightThresholdInput = input.float(20.0, "Asian 'Tight' Threshold (Pips)", minval = 0, group = G_SESS)

fastMaLenInput = input.int(20, "Fast MA Length", minval = 1, group = G_MA)
slowMaLenInput = input.int(50, "Slow MA Length", minval = 1, group = G_MA)

rrInput        = input.float(2.0, "Risk/Reward Ratio", minval = 0.1, group = G_VIS)
stopLossPips   = input.float(12.0, "Stop Loss (Pips)", minval = 1, group = G_VIS)
riskAmount     = input.float(750.0, "Risk Amount ($)", minval = 1, group = G_VIS)
trendFilter    = input.bool(true, "Trend Filter (EMA Cross)", group = G_VIS)

// --- Helper Functions ---
is_in_session(sess, tz) => not na(time(timeframe.period, sess, tz))

// --- Logic ---
inAsia   = is_in_session(asiaSessInput, timeZoneInput)
inLondon = is_in_session(londonSessInput, timeZoneInput)
inNY     = is_in_session(nySessInput, timeZoneInput)

var float asiaHigh = na
var float asiaLow  = na
var int   asiaStart = na

if inAsia and not inAsia[1]
    asiaHigh  := high
    asiaLow   := low
    asiaStart := bar_index
else if inAsia
    asiaHigh  := math.max(asiaHigh, high)
    asiaLow   := math.min(asiaLow, low)

// EMA Trend
fastMa = ta.ema(close, fastMaLenInput)
slowMa = ta.ema(close, slowMaLenInput)
plot(fastMa, "Fast EMA", color.new(C_RED, 20))
plot(slowMa, "Slow EMA", color.new(C_BLUE, 20))

// --- Forecasting Tool Visual Function ---
draw_forecaster(isLong, entry, sl, tp, width = 30) =>
    float pnlDist = math.abs(tp - entry)
    float slDist  = math.abs(entry - sl)
    float pips    = slDist / syminfo.mintick / 10
    float perc    = (slDist / entry) * 100
    float qty     = math.round(riskAmount / slDist)
    float targetAmount = qty * pnlDist

    // Tool Background Boxes
    box.new(bar_index, isLong ? entry : sl, bar_index + width, isLong ? sl : entry, bgcolor = color.new(C_RED, 80), border_color = C_RED, border_width = 1)
    box.new(bar_index, isLong ? tp : entry, bar_index + width, isLong ? entry : tp, bgcolor = color.new(C_GREEN, 80), border_color = C_GREEN, border_width = 1)
    
    // Entry Line
    line.new(bar_index, entry, bar_index + width, entry, color = color.new(chart.fg_color, 50), style = line.style_solid, width = 1)

    // Center Info Label (Closed P&L Style)
    string centerTxt = "Closed P&L: " + str.tostring(pnlDist, "#.#####") + ", Qty: " + str.tostring(qty) + "\nRisk/reward ratio: " + str.tostring(rrInput)
    label.new(bar_index + width/2, entry, centerTxt, color = C_GREEN, textcolor = color.white, style = label.style_label_center, size = size.small)

    // Top/Bottom Labels (SL/TP)
    string tpTxt = "Target: " + str.tostring(pnlDist, "#.#####") + " (" + str.tostring((pnlDist/entry)*100, "0.###") + "%) " + str.tostring(pnlDist/syminfo.mintick/10, "0.0") + ", Amount: " + str.tostring(targetAmount, "0.00")
    string slTxt = "Stop: " + str.tostring(slDist, "#.#####") + " (" + str.tostring(perc, "0.###") + "%) " + str.tostring(pips, "0.0") + ", Amount: " + str.tostring(riskAmount)
    
    label.new(bar_index + width, tp, tpTxt, color = C_GREEN, textcolor = color.white, style = isLong ? label.style_label_down : label.style_label_up, size = size.tiny)
    label.new(bar_index + width, sl, slTxt, color = C_RED, textcolor = color.white, style = isLong ? label.style_label_up : label.style_label_down, size = size.tiny)

// --- Strategy Tracking ---
var int totalTrades = 0
var int wins = 0
var int losses = 0
var bool asiaHighSwept = false
var bool asiaLowSwept = false

if inAsia and not inAsia[1]
    asiaHighSwept := false
    asiaLowSwept := false

if (inLondon or inNY) and not na(asiaHigh)
    float slDist = stopLossPips * syminfo.mintick * 10
    
    // Long Setup
    if low < asiaLow and close > asiaLow and not asiaLowSwept
        if not trendFilter or fastMa > slowMa
            float sl = close - slDist
            float tp = close + (close - sl) * rrInput
            draw_forecaster(true, close, sl, tp)
            asiaLowSwept := true
            totalTrades += 1
            if high[15] > close // Simulation logic
                wins += 1
            else
                losses += 1

    // Short Setup
    else if high > asiaHigh and close < asiaHigh and not asiaHighSwept
        if not trendFilter or fastMa < slowMa
            float sl = close + slDist
            float tp = close - (sl - close) * rrInput
            draw_forecaster(false, close, sl, tp)
            asiaHighSwept := true
            totalTrades += 1
            if low[15] < close // Simulation logic
                wins += 1
            else
                losses += 1

// --- Dashboard ---
var table perfTable = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 3, bgcolor = C_BG, border_color = color.gray, border_width = 1)
if barstate.islast
    winRate = totalTrades > 0 ? (wins / totalTrades) * 100 : 0
    table.cell(perfTable, 0, 0, "PERFORMANCE", text_color = color.white, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(perfTable, 1, 0, "STATS", text_color = color.white, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(perfTable, 0, 1, "Win Rate", text_color = color.white)
    table.cell(perfTable, 1, 1, str.tostring(winRate, "0.0") + "%", text_color = winRate > 50 ? C_GREEN : C_RED)
    table.cell(perfTable, 0, 2, "W/L Ratio", text_color = color.white)
    table.cell(perfTable, 1, 2, str.tostring(wins) + "W / " + str.tostring(losses) + "L", text_color = color.white)

// --- Session Box ---
if inAsia
    var box aBox = na
    if not inAsia[1]
        aBox := box.new(bar_index, asiaHigh, bar_index, asiaLow, bgcolor = color.new(color.gray, 90), border_color = color.gray, text = "Asia", text_size = size.tiny)
    else
        box.set_top(aBox, asiaHigh)
        box.set_bottom(aBox, asiaLow)
        box.set_right(aBox, bar_index)
